sentences: UNORM/SNORM stores (`Gen.encode_norm_bits`) round the exact product `clamp(x) * scale` once in 64-bit integer arithmetic with ties away from zero, instead of double-rounding through `OpFMul` + `RoundEven` (`UNORM16(0.3)` stores 19661, not 19660; `SNORM2(±0.5)` stores ±1).

MUBUF `buffer_store_format_*` (and `_d16_*`) into 2-component formats infer `COMP_SWAP` from V# `DST_SEL_X/Y/Z`: `use_y = (sy >= 4) and (sz < 4)`, `rev = (sx != 4) and (sy >= 4 or sz >= 4)` (`XY01` → `(x, y)`, `YX01` → `(y, x)`, `XYZW` → `(x, w)` so `_xy` writes `(x, 0)`, `YXZW`/`ZYXW` → `(w, x)`); MTBUF `tbuffer_store_format_*` ignores `DST_SEL` and always stores `(x, y)`.

Measured natively on RDNA2 (`gfx1036`, AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D iGPU, Linux AMDGPU DRM via `tools/hw_oracle`, wave32 and wave64) with `tools/buffer_store_probe.py`: 0 mismatches across 5 UNORM/SNORM formats (2,474 inputs × MUBUF/MTBUF × wave32/64 = 9,896 runs) + SNORM2 ties, all 12 2-component formats (`XY01` vs `XYZW`), and all 216 `(sx, sy, sz)` triples on `32_32_UINT`.
